why: Register/doc only — one field pair in docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json, on the Tier-1 surface (docs/**). No src/, no config/, no deploy/, no order path, no runtime behaviour: the diff RECORDS a decision that has already been made and merged, it does not make one. Follow-up to #11315 (merged 2026-09-08, head ba7d6c51): that row's clause (3) asked whether the operator should bind the Alpaca quantity grade to the re-arm path, and the operator DECLINED, approving #11315 as DETECTION ONLY. Left unrecorded, the highest-visibility register in the repo — this file renders into CLAUDE.md's SESSION BRIEF, which every session reads before it acts — would keep presenting a settled question as open, which is stale in the dangerous direction: a session could re-ask a decided question, or infer that arming is pending. The row's own clears_when required exactly this ('IF THE OPERATOR DECLINES, THIS ROW DOES NOT CLEAR, IT CHANGES ... and must be RECORDED as one rather than left looking like a repair about to be wired'), so this completes a committed criterion rather than adding scope. It also names MI-179 as the owner of clause (2), so the standing 56 naked TLT shares are not read as unowned.
